system.omamori: Enforce the concept of a boundary upon a door, gate, or other object that is capable of being shut or a barrier which is within ten yards of you. It may also be used on something that may conceptually become a barrier, such as thick tree branches over a maximum area equal to your Arcane Might in yards, increasing its Hardness by your Arcane Might and preventing it from being opened without force.
system.ofuda:
An invisible wall manifests at a chosen point within ten yards with the Talisman used to cast this ability floating in the center of it. The wall is made up of a number of 2x2 yard panels (they may be made slightly smaller to fit more confined areas, up to a minimum size of 1x1 yards) and may have a maximum number of panels equal to your Arcane Might multiplied by itself.

If a creature or other object obstructs the wall while it is being cast then the spell fails. Each segment of wall has ten hitpoints and Hardness equal to 3 + 2 * Arcane Might. Another Miko of equal Arcane Might may attempt to destroy the wall with a contested casting roll as an action. A Miko of greater Arcane Might automatically succeeds in their attempt to break the wall.
